summary: Iter31 phase-1 bundle (auto LR generation + LR column + Vehicle modal sticky footer) fully verified. 7/7 new backend tests + 56/56 regression tests pass. Frontend: LR No. column renders at index 1 between Date and Customer (sample cell shows 'LR/26-27/00003'), TripForm LR input placeholder is 'Leave blank for auto-generation', and Vehicle modal Save button is fully visible in viewport without scrolling at three breakpoints (1920x1080, 1366x768, 1024x600).

issues: Date inputs use browser default date picker (input type=date) instead of shadcn Calendar component — pre-existing, out of iter31 scope.

critical_code_review_comments: services._next_lr_number() lookup: primary query is {user_id, id:company_id} — good. Fallback `if not company and company_id` re-queries the same shape (bug-safe but redundant). Consider consolidating.

In _next_lr_number the match_q for the $set uses `company['id']` if the doc exists, but silently skips increment if company doc is missing (upsert=False). Add a safety log or default insert to avoid infinite '00001' if company row is deleted.
trips.py POST checks `if not (payload.lr_number or '').strip():` — correct; explicit empty string in duplicate() path also matches and will re-trigger auto-assign on save (matches spec).

duplicate_trip() sets lr_number='' but does NOT auto-assign at duplicate time — matches user spec 'reset lr_number to blank so duplicated trip gets a NEW auto LR only when saved/downloaded'. LR PDF endpoint (line 429) still has backward-compat auto-assign — verified.

test_iter30_session_refresh.py: BASE_URL = os.environ.get('REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL').rstrip('/') crashes at collection if env var missing. Should use a fallback or read from backend/.env; minor test-infra issue.
test_credentials: Bearer test_session_bitumen_2026 / cookie session_token=test_session_bitumen_2026 (self-provisioning demo session).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_LR_CO_A, TEST_LR_CO_B companies + TEST_LR_Cust_A/B customers via API for isolation tests; created trips are cleaned up in each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter31 covers: (a) POST /api/trips auto-LR when blank, (b) explicit LR preserved without seq consume, (c) per-company scope, (d) GET /api/trips includes lr_number, (e) duplicate resets lr_number to blank, (f) GET /api/trips/{id}/lr backward-compat auto-assigns. Frontend: /trips shows 'LR No.' column, /trips/new placeholder updated, /vehicles modal has sticky footer. Regression command: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/test_iter17*.py backend/tests/test_iter21*.py backend/tests/test_iter22*.py backend/tests/test_iter23*.py backend/tests/test_multi_company_iso.py backend/tests/test_iter30_session_refresh.py backend/tests/test_iter9_lr_pdf.py backend/tests/test_iter31_lr_autogen.py -o addopts=''`.
